answers.api_provider: Google AI (Gemini); DeepSeek (DeepSeek); Alibaba Cloud DashScope (Qwen)
answers.description: A reference-free, LLM-ensemble quality-estimation system. Three independent LLM judges (Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen Plus) annotate each translation under an MQM/ESA-style protocol; a neutral cross-verification stage re-judges every proposed span, and a dedicated source-coverage stage detects omissions. The verified per-character judge masks are fused by CHARACTER-LEVEL MAJORITY VOTE (a character is marked erroneous when at least two of the three judges cover it), giving Task-1 error spans with minor/major severity and an omission label. The Task-2 quality score is an inverse-variance fusion of a reliability-weighted holistic estimator and a span-derived MQM-penalty estimator (span confidence = vote share; judge reliability = agreement with the consensus), clamped to [0,100]. The Task-3 error-free label is an adequacy-gated conjunction (no error spans, no omission, and holistic quality at or above threshold). No reference translations are used at any stage.
